meta.name: ad-account-auditor
meta.description: Use when auditing a paid ad account for incremental contribution, wasted spend, or measurement integrity before scaling; runs a typed 20-item ROAS profile with verified vetoes and a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK/UNDECIDED gate on own exported data. Not for campaign structure design — use campaign-architect; not for creative production — use ad-creative-builder. 付费广告账户审计/ROAS评分

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计付费广告账户的增量贡献与浪费支出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在管理付费广告账户并需要评估投放效果与优化方向
copy.tagline_en: Audit paid ad accounts for incremental contribution and wasted spend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid ad accounts and need to evaluate performance and optimize spend

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你导出的广告账户数据，从回报、广告、受众、花费效率四个维度打分，并检查五个红线否决项，最终给出“可放量/需修复/禁止放量”的审计结论。
howto.when: 当你准备提高广告预算，或询问“这个账户能放量吗”“为什么浪费钱”时触发。也适用于怀疑跟踪、归因或品牌安全问题。

say.text: 审计这个Google Ads账户的ROAS，目标是DR/效果。
say.note: Claude会要求你提供广告系列导出、GA4转化导出等数据。

say.text: 检查我的Meta账户有没有测量和归因问题，目标是拉新。
say.note: Claude会检查R1/R2等否决项，并给出审计报告。

say.text: 在放量前跑一次广告账户审计，这是搜索词报告和GA4导出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your exported ad account data, scores it on four dimensions (Return, Offer, Audience, Spend-efficiency), checks five red-line vetoes, and outputs a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK verdict for scaling readiness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are about to increase ad budgets, or ask 'is this account ready to scale' or 'why am I wasting spend'. Also applies when you suspect tracking, attribution, or brand-safety issues.

say_en.text: Audit this Google Ads account for ROAS. Goal is DR/performance.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for campaign export, GA4 conversions export, etc.

say_en.text: Check my Meta account for measurement and attribution problems. Prospecting goal.
say_en.note: Claude checks R1/R2 vetoes and produces an audit report.

say_en.text: Run an ad-account audit before I scale. Here's the search-terms report and GA4 export.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full audit and outputs a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK verdict.
